test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The magazine teaches parents __how to behaves towards__ children.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. 'How to behave towards'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Option 2 is the correct answer** because** it uses the correct verb form,** "behave,"** which is the base form of the verb. 
 
• 'To' is always followed by the **V1** form of **verb**.
 
 
• ​For example: I am going **to win** the competition.
 
 
 
• It follows the proper structure **"how to + V1" **to **indicate the action or behavior** that parents should adopt towards their children. 
 
• This option provides a grammatically correct and clear expression of the intended meaning. 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The magazine teaches parents how to behave towards children'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of why the other options are incorrect:
 
 
• "How should behave towards their" - This option is grammatically incorrect because it uses the incorrect verb form "should behave" instead of the base form "behave." It creates a subject-verb agreement error.
 
• "How will behave towards" - This option is also grammatically incorrect because it uses the future tense verb form "will behave" instead of the base form "behave." It does not convey the intended meaning of providing instructions or guidance in the present tense.
 
• "How to behaving their" - This option is grammatically incorrect as it uses the gerund form "to behaving" instead of the base form "behave." It does not follow the correct verb form required in the sentence and disrupts the intended meaning.
